Replicate feature based on regular expression

keep_reps_regex.Rd

use a regular expression on the filename to gather the groups of samples in the batch into sets. Then apply the keepReps function on each of these sets in turn. This will be quite slow because we are looping through the sets and each set loops through each row. But it is the easiest way for now.

Usage 

keep_reps_regex(alignment, samples, sampleList, regexp, least)

Arguments

alignment

alignment table (matrix, grouped)

samples

Sample IDs which should be considered (e.g. only samples and no blanks)

sampleList

Sample list dataframe with columns ID, File etc.

regexp

string length 1 regular expression by which to group the samples into replicates this is done removing the matching string with stringr::str_replace(filename, regexp, "\1"). The part of the regexp in brackets is kept (\1) and so should be the same in all replicates.

least

How many times does the feature need to appear. Must be less than the number of replicates in each group. If it is higher, will be changed to the number of replicates in the group with a message.

Value

alignment table with rows removed where the number of aligned features in each replicate set is less than 'least'.
